reference.title: High temperature and high pressure equation of state of gold

recalculation.notes: Tables 1-2 preserve the row-wise Au V/V0 observations and their uncertainties, but the Matsui (2010) Au thermal EOS is not bundled as an executable Peritheos calibration record.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

primary_source_check.finding: The source defines a reference-subtracted 300 K BM3-MGD EOS for stoichiometric high-spin (Mg0.83Fe0.17)O, fitted only below 47 GPa.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Table 3 (pp. 178-179) with Equations (1)-(6); K0 and theta0 are fixed from MgO and ferropericlase literature, and gamma0 and q are fitted to the 700 and 1100 K rows.

primary_data_check.finding: Every printed temperature, ferropericlase conventional-cell volume, Au V/V0, observed/calculated pressure, residual, and parenthetical uncertainty is transcribed; the high-pressure rows remain explicit exclusions.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experiments, page 177; Equations (1)-(6), pages 178-179; Tables 1 and 3, pages 178-179; High-spin to low-spin transition, page 180.
parameter_provenance.equation: Equations (1)-(6), pages 178-179: 300 K BM3 plus a Mie-Gruneisen-Debye thermal-pressure increment E_D(V,T)-E_D(V,300 K).
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 3: V0=75.849(11) A^3, fitted from the 300 K rows below 47 GPa.
parameter_provenance.K0: Table 3 and page 179: K0T=160 GPa, fixed from the MgO literature.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table 3: K0T'=4.08(2), fitted from the 300 K rows below 47 GPa.
parameter_provenance.theta0: Table 3 and page 179: theta0=500 K, fixed from ferropericlase literature.
parameter_provenance.gamma0: Table 3: gamma0=1.53(4), fitted to the 700 and 1100 K rows below 47 GPa.
parameter_provenance.q: Table 3: q=0.7(2), fitted to the 700 and 1100 K rows below 47 GPa.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: The 300 K BM3 fit and subsequent 700/1100 K thermal fit use measured rows below 47 GPa; all higher-pressure rows are retained but excluded because the source limits the EOS to high-spin Fe2+.
parameter_provenance.weighting: Least-squares fitting is stated for gamma0 and q, but the source does not publish weights, covariance, or the numerical fitting program.

superseded_record_text.notes: The thermal term is the source's explicitly reference-subtracted increment from 300 K, not absolute Debye pressure. Parameter errors are the printed parenthetical values; the confidence convention and covariance are not reported.
validity_notes: Valid only for the high-spin B1 branch; the paper deliberately excludes observations at and above the approximately 47 GPa cutoff from fitting.
The dataset retains all measurements through 55.47 GPa to expose the onset and growth of the spin-crossover volume anomaly.

assessment.basis: The primary figure supplies 43 V/V0,HS observations but not the absolute V0,HS normalization, so all six absolute Table 7 coefficients are not independently identifiable.
